assay_run.method: Stereo-seq library Sample1 from chip SS200000171BL_D3. OCT-embedded, 10-μm heart cryosections were methanol-fixed at −20 °C for 40 min, followed by on-chip mRNA capture, reverse transcription, cDNA amplification and DNB sequencing. Reads were processed using SAW v5.1.4. Sequencer naming differs between the article and GEO sample metadata.
